# Implementation Plan: CodeRabbit Security, Logic & Performance Remediation + Render CD Pipeline

**Branch**: `001-coderabbit-review-fixes` | **Date**: 2026-11-10 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/001-coderabbit-review-fixes/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan was generated by the `/speckit-plan` workflow and validated against `.specify/memory/constitution.md` (v1.0.0).

## Summary

Remediate all 12 security, business logic, and performance findings identified in `docs/CodeReview-Coderabbit.md` across the **CareConnect API (`caregiving-system`)** codebase, and update the Continuous Deployment configuration (`.github/workflows/deploy.yml` and `.env.example`) so **Render** is the sole deployment target—triggering exclusively after the `CI` workflow succeeds (`workflow_run` with `conclusion == 'success'` or manual `workflow_dispatch`) and eliminating any remaining Vercel references or unverified `push` deploys.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: TypeScript 6.0.2 on Node.js 24 / Bun 1.x

**Primary Dependencies**: NestJS 12 (`@nestjs/common`, `@nestjs/core`, `@nestjs/jwt`, `@nestjs/passport`, `@nestjs/typeorm`, `@nestjs/swagger`, `@nestjs/throttler`, `@nestjs/event-emitter`, `@nestjs/observe`), TypeORM 1.1.2, Express 5.3.0, `class-validator`, `class-transformer`, `bcrypt`, `helmet`

**Storage**: PostgreSQL 16 (via `pg` 8.23.1 and TypeORM) + local `/uploads/documents` storage for caregiver documents

**Testing**: Jest 30 (`bun run test`, `bun run test:cov`), Supertest 7 (`bun run test:e2e`), Newman 6 (`bun run test:postman`), Oxlint (`bun run lint`)

**Target Platform**: Linux container / Render Cloud Web Service (`https://caregiving-system.onrender.com/api/v1`)

**Project Type**: Modular RESTful Web Service (`NestJS` backend API)

**Performance Goals**: Eliminate $1 + N$ SQL queries in `JobOffersService.getMyOffers` and replace unbounded in-memory filtering/counting in `HistoryService` and `ReportsService` with SQL-level queries

**Constraints**: Preserve 100% compatibility with existing E2E (`test/app.e2e-spec.ts`) and Postman/Newman (`postman/CareConnect_API.postman_collection.json`) contract assertions; enforce strict path-traversal containment under `./uploads/documents`; deploy exclusively to Render after CI passes

**Scale/Scope**: 10 domain modules under `src/`, 33 unit test suites, E2E test suite (`test/app.e2e-spec.ts`), Postman collections (`postman/`), `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`, and `.env.example`

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-check after Phase 1 design.*

### Pre-Phase 0 Gate Evaluation (`.specify/memory/constitution.md` v1.0.0)

- **Principle I — Domain-Driven Modularity & Strict Contracts**: **PASS**. All changes remain encapsulated within existing NestJS domain modules (`auth`, `users`, `caregivers`, `admin`, `job-offers`, `applications`, `reviews`, `history`, `reports`). DTO validation uses `class-validator` and `class-transformer` under `/api/v1`, and removing the unresolved Postman variable fallbacks strengthens strict UUID contract enforcement.
- **Principle II — Security, RBAC & Privacy-by-Design (NON-NEGOTIABLE)**: **PASS**. Enforces 2FA challenge verification (`challengeToken`/`password`), blocks overwriting active 2FA secrets, hashes password reset tokens with SHA-256, redacts sensitive tokens from non-test logs, sanitizes document filenames against path traversal, and normalizes email case across all auth flows.
- **Principle III — Transactional Data Integrity & Auditable State**: **PASS**. Preserves existing `QueryRunner` transactions and fixes `AdminService.verifyDocument` so `CaregiverProfile.isDocumentVerified` is deterministically recomputed on both `APPROVED` and `REJECTED` transitions.
- **Principle IV — Multi-Layer Testing & Quality Gates (NON-NEGOTIABLE)**: **PASS**. Plan requires updating and passing unit specs (`src/**/*.spec.ts`), E2E tests (`test/app.e2e-spec.ts`), Postman/Newman contract tests (`bun run test:postman`), `tsc --noEmit`, `oxlint`, and `nest build`.
- **Principle V — Living OpenAPI Specification & Observability**: **PASS**. Updates `@ApiPropertyOptional` / `@ApiOperation` on `TwoFactorAuthenticateDto` and `AuthController`, redacts sensitive reset tokens in `Logger`, and wires `@nestjs/observe` credentials via `ConfigService`.

### Post-Phase 1 Design Re-Check

- **Research (`research.md`)**: All 12 findings and Render CD requirements have concrete, non-breaking technical decisions. **PASS**.
- **Data Model (`data-model.md`) & Contracts (`contracts/api-and-ci-contracts.md`)**: DTO, entity, endpoint, and GitHub Actions workflow contracts are fully specified and backwards-compatible with Newman and Supertest suites. **PASS**.
- **Repository Scope Constraint**: Only governed application, test, CI/CD, and configuration files are targeted for modification during implementation. **PASS**.
